text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle, Mr. C.B. was 
defeated.
It was Katsuragi Ace who claimed 
victory in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd lamented that Mr.
C.B.'s Classic 
Triple Crown dream had been shattered.
Yet 
even so, they praised her performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having raced through covered head-to-toe 
in mud,
Mr. C.B. expresses her frustration 
over the defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her fighting spirit burns as she vows to 
pay Katsuragi Ace back for today's
defeat. 
Her next goal is the Japanese Derby.
